purpose: Centralized Norse-themed UX copy for Woody's Realm AIOS dashboard. Empty states, errors, loading messages, success confirmations, tooltips, microcopy. Each entry honors the Theros × Hades × Norse skin without breaking immersion.

voice.tone: Mythic, weighty, occasionally wry. Speaks to Lord Woody as a sovereign, not a user. Never breaks the fourth wall with words like 'click', 'tap', 'browser'.
rules: Address as Lord Woody (or just 'my Lord' in shorter strings)
Use Norse vocabulary where natural: Wyrd, Hoard, Forge, Saga, Mímir, Heimdall, Hugin, Munin, Bifrost, Yggdrasil
Avoid contractions in dramatic copy ('do not' over 'don't'). Allow contractions in conversational microcopy.
No exclamation points except in errors of consequence
No emojis in body copy. Reserve emoji for icon slots only.
Short and weighted. A single Norse phrase outranks three modern sentences.

memory.body: No memories yet. Live, work, and Mímir will fill it.

memorySearch.title: Mímir does not know that

deleteMemory.title: Release this memory?
deleteMemory.body: It will be removed from the well and the index. This cannot be undone.

deleteTask.title: Strike this from the slate?
deleteTask.body: The task will be removed entirely. Done tasks should be marked done, not deleted.

costThreshold.title: Confirm the offering
costThreshold.body: This consultation is estimated to cost beyond the line. The All-Father asks before spending past it.

archiveOlder.title: Send to the deep archive?
archiveOlder.body: Items archived can still be recovered later. They simply pass beyond the active watch.

logoutSession.title: Close the watch?
logoutSession.body: The session will end. Unsaved drafts will be released.
